echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen plus 22.5% ATK for the next Resonator on Outro. Bell-Borne Geochelone's shield and damage reduction transfer to the team.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: More defensive sustain for survival-focused builds; boosts her healing-adjacent utility.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; moderate — Energy Regen is 4th in her substat priorities (Liberation costs 140 energy)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Dauntless Evernight (Discord for faster rotations) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Bell-Borne Geochelone in the main slot. Run CRIT Rate/DMG on the 4-cost, Havoc DMG on the 3-cost, DEF% on 1-costs — her shields and Liberation scale on DEF, and her Outro hands the next Resonator a Resonance Skill DMG amp.

ranked_weapons.name: Dauntless Evernight
ranked_weapons.note: Best weapon: DEF substat — her shields and Liberation scale on DEF — plus ATK and DEF on Intro Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill for faster rotations.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Stacking ATK on Basic/Heavy hits; decent stat stick for her on-field moments.

ranked_weapons.name: Broadblade#41
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable 4-star with a Resonance Skill-triggered ATK buff.

ranked_weapons.name: Originite: Type I
ranked_weapons.note: Free 3-star with a DEF substat; heals on Resonance Skill cast.

stat_priorities.note: Game8 lists CRIT; a DEF% 4-cost is viable for a pure tank build.
Havoc DMG for personal damage; Energy Regen is an option if Liberation uptime suffers.
DEF% on both 1-costs — feeds her shields and Liberation scaling.

profile.role_note: DEF-scaling defensive support with Rocksteady damage-reduction shields and timed Strategic Parries. Her Outro amplifies the next Resonator's Resonance Skill DMG, and her Liberation hits hard off DEF on quick swaps.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A defensive support with a Resonance Skill DMG Outro that Jinhsi loves — genuinely useful in that one team, but too niche to pull for.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Taoqi
members.note: Sub-DPS/support; quick-swaps in for timed parries, shields, and her Liberation, then Outros the Resonance Skill DMG buff.

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Main DPS; most of her damage comes from Resonance Skill, which Taoqi's Outro amplifies.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and sustain; also accelerates Jinhsi's Incandescence gain.

teams.name: Premium: Jinhsi + Taoqi + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with Liberation, Jinhsi builds Incandescence and bursts, then Taoqi quick-swaps in for parries and her DEF-scaling Liberation before Outroing — handing Jinhsi a Resonance Skill DMG amp for her next burst.

members.name: Taoqi
members.note: Support; shields and Outro buff for Danjin's frequent Resonance Skill casts.

members.name: Danjin
members.note: Main DPS; appreciates Taoqi's Outro buff on her constant Resonance Skill usage.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing, team ATK buff, and DMG Deepen with off-field coordinated attacks.

teams.name: Alternative: Danjin + Taoqi + Verina
teams.rotation: Verina sustains and deepens team damage, Taoqi parries and shields on quick swap, then Danjin takes extended on-field time with Taoqi's Resonance Skill DMG Outro boosting her frequent casts.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates her Overall C as a Sub-DPS (C in both Tower of Adversity and Whimpering Wastes); Beebom's 3.7 tier list also places her in C — niche defensive value, outscaled as a general support.
